title: Mini-Apps
subtitle: Create, build, publish, and run full-stack mini-apps in a dedicated workbench

errors.loadLibraryTitle: Failed to load the mini-app library
errors.loadWorkshopTitle: Failed to load the mini-app workbench
errors.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted or belong to another user.

create.title: Create a mini-app project
create.intro: Start with a new Project and Product. Source, build, test, and publish stay in the dedicated mini-app workbench.
create.uiOnlyHint: Static UI plus Host KV only; no Node process is started at any point.
create.serviceHint: Includes one managed main.mjs Service with Host KV, Files, and Private DB.

library.heading: MiniApp Library
library.hint: Only clean-start M1 Products appear here; legacy single-HTML mini-apps are never read or migrated.
library.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, description, or state
library.emptyBody: Create an independent Project and begin with Source → Build → Ready → Publish.
library.noMatchBody: Adjust the search and try again.

workshop.pageSubtitle: Manage Source, Build, Ready Release, Publish, capabilities, configuration, and Service state

identity.title: Identity and source
identity.hint: Product and Project are separate facts; a Release consumes only frozen Source and dependency lock inputs.

source.emptyNotice: This Project has no Source yet. Chat Dev or a managed Source import must create it; the product never falls back to the legacy single-file workspace.
source.runtimeOnlyNotice: This is a source-less runtime artifact. It can be tested and published; continued development requires an explicit Source import or fork.

releases.title: Release pointers
releases.hint: At most one Ready, one Active, and one Previous release are retained; there is no arbitrary version history.

ready.title: Ready Release
ready.hint: A successful Build creates one frozen Ready release; Publish binds exact pointer and Release digests.
ready.emptyBody: A new immutable Release appears here after Source builds successfully.

configuration.title: Configuration and Credential references
configuration.hint: Configuration contains non-secret values. Credentials are slot → credential_id references only; plaintext is never shown here.

capabilities.title: Published capabilities
capabilities.hint: The Active Release materializes {{count}} platform capabilities. Agent Workbench consumes only those available to the agent surface.
capabilities.emptyBody: Draft and Ready releases never enter the platform Catalog; only a published Active Release can provide capabilities.

service.title: Service state
service.hint: UI-only apps never start Node. A full-stack mini-app has at most one dedicated main Service.
service.uiOnly: This is a UI-only mini-app. Rust terminates Host KV directly, and the Node process count must remain zero.
service.noDescriptor: There is no runnable Service Release yet.

operation.title: Current Operation
operation.hint: Only Build, Import, Export, and permanent deletion are durable Operations.
operation.emptyBody: Short transactional commands are not disguised as long-running jobs.
